column1: Sensor - Indicates which sensor collected the data;
Timestamp - Represents the moment (in milliseconds) when the data was collected;
Value_X - Represents X-axis values for accelerometer and gyroscope
Value_Y - Represents Y-axis values for accelerometer and gyroscope
Value_Z - Represents Z-axis values for accelerometer and gyroscope
AHRS - Attitude and Heading Reference System;
GPS - minutes and seconds (Value_X and Value_Y)
